claim: On the AWS Security Hub pricing page, the Security Hub Essentials plan combines Amazon Inspector and Security Hub CSPM capabilities into a single resource-based pricing model, and the page names transitioning from usage-based to resource-based pricing, with unlimited security checks and finding ingestions, as a benefit of that plan.
note: d073. adjudicate-09: kind changed from change to pricing-dimension; the page offers the move as a plan benefit and does not say that existing Security Hub CSPM customers are moved; the CSPM guide still describes usage-based charges for findings and checks.
